verdict_text:
YES

The script drops head 5 with the correct index construction: for the fused `query_key_value` weight and bias it selects along dim 0 in 768-row head blocks (keeping `0..3839` then `4608..6143`, in ascending order), and for `attention.dense.weight` it selects along dim 1 in 256-column blocks (keeping `0..1279` then `1536..2047`). It touches only the three head-bearing tensors for all 16 layers, leaves names and every other tensor untouched, preserves float16 via `index_select`, asserts all four required checks before writing, and saves a single `out/T2/model.safetensors`.
